Stop the version at the first failure and preserve earlier successful/failed evidence. Do not hold the earlier students/Trainers/optimizers live while loading the next child.
fresh_process_choreography.parent: The supervisor owns only bounded metadata and child process identities. It must not retain a CUDA model, hidden state, gradient, optimizer or oracle from a child, nor load/offload a fourth model. Fresh children load the same unchanged original files, never a previous diagnostic checkpoint.
fresh_process_choreography.isolation_proof: Record child PIDs, assigned device identities, original file/source/cache hashes and actual phase entry/exit accounting. A terminated child is a hard resource-release boundary; sampled allocator reset does not by itself prove process exit. All children belong to the same explicitly admitted finite allocation. fresh_process_choreography.ga9_unchanged: Use the frozen run_paired_training_steps API with two newly constructed zero-forward Trainers, nine sealed presentations, actual groups8+1, two real optimizer updates and full-horizon cosine prefix. graph_free_projection_phase.placement: Within the fresh standalone child, before any actual training_step and with every Trainer training_forward_examples counter still0, run the three unchanged short witnesses one at a time. graph_free_projection_phase.positions: Use the complete native input <=512 total tokens and exact unshifted cache labels. A target at native position j uses final-normalized predecessor hidden j-1; align once, choose every active response/EOS/tail predecessor in ascending target order and preserve the original full causal context. No prefix-only context, response-only restart, second shift or omitted EOS/tail is permitted. Bind witness, token, label, mask, prefix and suffix identities privately.
graph_free_projection_phase.dense_oracle: Call the original dense tied head once on the ORIGINAL full final-normalized short hidden tensor [1,L,H], including every prompt position and the last unused predecessor position. Do not gather only active hidden states before this dense projection: GEMM row shape can affect BF16 rounding, and the frozen dense preserving path projects the entire complete short context before applying its sole causal shift/mask. Require the returned original-head tensor to be actual graph-free CUDA BF16 [1,L,151936], 2<=L<=512, on the assigned device. Hold at most ONE such complete student-or-reference oracle tensor at a time. Its data bound is512*151936*2=155582464 bytes. This explicitly allowed CUDA oracle allocation is separate from, and must be included alongside, the <=128MiB comparison HOST-scratch bound.
graph_free_projection_phase.candidate: For the corresponding candidate or frozen-reference role, call the unchanged original tied head on actual aligned rank2 hidden chunks of128 active predecessor positions except the final shorter chunk, in ascending target order under the same actual autocast. Require actual BF16 outputs and matching vocabulary. Target j compares against dense oracle predecessor position j-1. With the required contiguous native active suffix, use zero-copy dense views [0,P-1:L-1,:] and their successive128-row slices; no advanced-index full copy or active-only dense head projection is permitted. Compare immediately using ProjectionComparison.observe, which transfers <=1048576 elements per host chunk and retains only aggregate statistics. Finish with exact total A*151936 coverage for A=L-P, including every response/EOS/tail target. Dense oracle prompt and final unused logits remain unscored. Apply the already frozen every-element BF16-ULP/global-relative-L2 policy. A failed or poisoned comparator cannot be reused.
graph_free_projection_phase.lifetime: The future worker explicitly owns the single local dense oracle variable; hooks record only bounded shape/dtype/context metadata and never retain outputs. Release each candidate output and comparison temporary before the next projection; release the oracle before the next student/reference role or witness. No external full-length candidate L-by-vocabulary tensor, graph retention, full CPU copy, disk full-logit spool or hidden oracle list is permitted. Final-normalized hidden tensors remain separately bounded by the short input and observed dtype.
graph_free_projection_phase.observations: Install source-bound original-module observers for this forward-only phase separately from the later standalone observer lifecycle. Record actual original backbone/head identities, full shapes/dtypes, CUDA BF16 context, no_grad state, explicit oracle bytes/lifetimes, exact block order/coverage and actual conservative memory/RSS envelope. The fixed observers' forward-only validation must not claim checkpoint recomputation; real backward observations come from actual standalone training_step.
graph_free_projection_phase.scope_and_remaining_integration: This phase establishes only its prospective head/hidden numeric comparisons if it actually passes. The future worker must implement the unchanged original/reference zero-update and candidate reload controls independently, with their original bounds and source-reviewed same-path semantics; it must not relabel the projection ULP result as those controls. No such original identity or reload implementation is supplied or admitted by this proposal.
